context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 139 verified the new CRED-style rolling buttons feature on the dashboard. Three pill-shaped buttons are visible below the header, each cycling through 4 items at different intervals (2.8s, 3.2s, 3.6s). Animation was confirmed working - labels changed from 'Accounts/Assets/Savings' to 'Cards/Insure/Debts' after 4 seconds. One bug was found and fixed: the 'Cards' button was navigating to '/credit-cards' instead of '/my-credit-cards'. After the fix, clicking the buttons correctly navigates to the appropriate routes. The onboarding modal respects the dismissed flag correctly.
